instructions: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: The departmental plotter has to be booked (27) ........ working days before the poster is needed.
items.evidence: It takes three working days, not two
items.explanation: Because everyone assumed it took two days, two groups missed the deadline last year; the plotter actually needs three working days.

items.prompt: The abstract has to be handed in on the (28) ........ , not on the date Anneke had written in her diary.
items.evidence: The abstract is due on the eighteenth.
items.explanation: Anneke has the eleventh in her diary, but that date was only for registering a title; the tutor tells them the abstract itself is due on the eighteenth.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: L4 cumle tamamlama 28 - bosluk baska bir cevap noktasina tasindi
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The tutor says a poster becomes far easier to read if a good deal of (28) ........ is left on it.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Genel kultur: 'posterde bolca ... birakilirsa okumak kolaylasir' kalibi grafik tasarimin ders kitabi ogudu; bosluga 'white space' 3/3 turda sesi dinlemeden yazildi. Sozcugun kendisi sizdiriyordu, cerceve degil.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1 (kaydirma). Senaryoya HIC dokunulmadi; bosluk ayni senaryonun keyfi bir degerine tasindi: ozet teslim tarihi (tur 25, L4-S3-23). Tarih dunya bilgisiyle tahmin edilemiyor ve senaryoda canli bir celdirici var (Anneke'nin ajandasindaki on bir, ki o tarih baslik kaydi icindi). Beyaz alan cumlesi senaryoda duruyor ama artik soruya bagli degil. Kalem sirasi korundu: 27 tur 21 < 28 tur 25 < 29 tur 27.

items.prompt: This year the research day is being held in the (29) ........ of the library.
items.explanation: Idris assumes it is the seminar block; the tutor corrects him: the event will be held in the library's atrium, a brighter but noisier space.

items.prompt: As all the readings were taken in summer, the study can say nothing about (30) ........ ground.
items.evidence: we have nothing at all on frozen ground
items.explanation: Because all eight weeks fell in the summer months, there is no data at all on frozen ground; the tutor wants them to write this up as a limitation.
